title: A row of bricks went up
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: Who is on your board, and how do they work together?

groups.heading: They were completely lying on their financial statements

lines.text: A student summed up: their stock plummets and loses billions. Jose said: the stock plummets because they realize the value isn't there. They were a sales organization grabbing market share at all costs. And then a bigger problem arises: they were lying completely on their financial statements.
That really is disappointing for the author, Jose said. He was a risk taker, but never a dishonest person with the numbers in his business.
Jose read a remark from someone close to the author about how the new chief executive handled him.
a row of bricks went up, I said, then another row was added, then another, and another, and another

Jose said that person felt the chief executive had built a wall insulating the author from the company, and was doing the same to another leader. A controlling, manipulative person. What worked against him was that the leader he did it to was a majority shareholder, who needed just a few allies on his side.

So the lesson for entrepreneurs, he said: get a board of advisors and see how they work together. The way a board of advisors work together is going to be indicative of how they are going to help your company grow.
Who in your circle is building a wall, and who is on your side?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the people who advise or govern your work.
Write how they work together, and with you.
Write any sign that someone is building a wall.
Write who you would call if you needed allies.
Write the honesty check you will keep on your own numbers.

check.q: What did Jose say the author was, but never dishonest with?
choices: A risk taker, never dishonest with the numbers

check.q: What did Jose say a board's way of working together is indicative of?
choices: How they will help your company grow

check.q: What image did the quote use?
choices: A row of bricks going up

recap: Watch how your advisors work together, and keep your numbers honest.
